mapper.select: select br.id, br.user_id as userId, ui.nick_name as nickName, ui.user_photo as userPhoto, br.review_content as reviewContent, br.stars, br.like_count as likeCount, br.reply_count as replyCount, br.create_time as createTime from book_reviews br inner join user_info ui on br.user_id = ui.id where br.book_id = #{bookId} and br.parent_id = #{parentId} and br.review_status = #{reviewStatus} order by br.create_time desc
